typed_representation.conceptual_form: Scheduler(admission, priority, batching, phase_control, kv_control, fairness, placement)

modules.name: PriorityRule
modules.output: ranked request list or per-request normalized score

operators.name: weighted_normalized_score_composition
operators.feasibility: Requires every member to expose a per-request score over the same candidate set.
operators.work_conservation: Good if followed by normal feasible-placement loop.
operators.starvation_risk: Medium unless age or fairness primitive is included.
operators.oscillation_risk: Medium with rapidly changing contextual weights.
operators.determinism: Yes if weights and normalization are deterministic.
operators.simulator_support: Requires small policy API extension; no simulator core change.
operators.recommendation: Do not add raw scores directly. Use percentile/rank normalization at minimum.

operators.name: weighted_borda_rank_aggregation
operators.feasibility: Requires policies or primitives to expose deterministic request rankings.
operators.work_conservation: Good with standard feasibility and placement checks.
operators.starvation_risk: Low to medium depending on members; add age tiebreak for safety.
operators.fairness_risk: Medium unless fairness primitive is present.
operators.oscillation_risk: Low for static weights; medium for contextual weights.
operators.determinism: Yes, except when random_feasible is included.
operators.simulator_support: Supported with small policy API/wrapper extension.

operators.name: reciprocal_rank_fusion
operators.determinism: Yes if member rankings are deterministic.
operators.simulator_support: Supported with small policy API/wrapper extension.
operators.recommendation: Good alternative to weighted Borda when top-rank agreement matters.

operators.name: pairwise_majority_preference
operators.form: For each request pair, aggregate member preferences and rank by tournament score.
operators.feasibility: O(n^2) in waiting queue; acceptable for small batches, risky under huge queues.
operators.recommendation: Useful diagnostic, not first production operator.

operators.name: conditional_composition
operators.form: IF condition(s): use module/policy A ELSE use module/policy B
operators.semantic_validity: YES if conditions use causal state only.
operators.feasibility: Straightforward for overload, KV pressure, phase pressure, SLO pressure.
operators.work_conservation: Good if each branch is valid.
operators.starvation_risk: Medium; branch hysteresis may be needed.
operators.simulator_support: Mostly supported today through policy-local logic.
operators.recommendation: Most expressive low-risk operator for causal state-dependent scheduling.

operators.name: component_wise_composition
operators.feasibility: Requires primitives to be factored out of monolithic policies.
operators.work_conservation: Good if admission guards cannot mask all feasible work indefinitely.
operators.starvation_risk: Low if aging/fairness is included; otherwise medium.
operators.simulator_support: Partially supported; small policy API refactor needed, no major simulator change for current modules.
operators.recommendation: Best long-term design for policy evolution.

operators.name: probabilistic_policy_mixing
operators.form: Choose policy k with probability w_k(s)
operators.feasibility: Easy to implement but harder to debug and evaluate.
operators.recommendation: Not recommended as first scientific composition operator.

normalization_requirements.reason: Several policies expose private score functions, but score scales and signs differ. Many policies only produce direct actions, rankings, binary admission decisions, or placement decisions.
normalization_requirements.recommended_common_representation: normalized deterministic per-request rank over the current candidate set, plus separate typed admission and placement modules
unsafe_transforms: mixing admission booleans with ranking scores without type separation
normalizing across future or held-out examples

SMALL_EXTENSION: add optional policy component API exposing rank_requests, admission_filter, choose_gpu, and module metadata
add immutable state snapshot/helper for calling multiple component policies without stateful side effects
add hysteresis/smoothing utility for conditional state-dependent weights
